title: Technicians at a book signing say the signal is still under study

tellings.quote: one of them says, "I was one of the technicians who was who acquired the signal, and it is the strangest signal we've ever acquired, and it's still under study."

plain: A writer named Whitley Strieber, known for describing encounters with strange beings, says that at a book signing in San Antonio, Texas, in the 2010s, some technicians came up to him. One of them, he says, told him he had helped pick up a certain signal, that it was the strangest signal they had ever received, and that it was still being studied. If true, it would mean experts are still puzzling over a signal they cannot explain.
